my_money_desc: See the money coming in, the fee deductions, and its withdrawal status.
my_money_bank_not_ready: Your bank account isn't ready yet.
my_money_none: There's no money available to withdraw yet. Money from completed orders will show up here.
my_money_pending_hint: Still waiting for orders to be completed.
my_money_pending_note: Money moves to Available money once orders are completed.
my_money_revenue_note: Includes completed transactions and ones in progress.
